items.title: Rome
items.note:
I wanted Rome to feel ancient yet alive, monumental yet quiet
a place where the Colosseum doesn’t dominate by size, but by presence
where the old basilicas breathe the same air as the modern skyline
where everything bends to the rhythm of the root shape.

Rome, to me, is not nostalgia.
It’s that impossible mix of fragility and endurance.
Things built to last forever, and yet weathered by time.
That tension is what I wanted to capture,

items.title: Lost In Town
items.note:
They walk.  
They go about their lives, each carrying their own stories, their own problems, their own fragile victories.  
Alone together, crossing the same streets yet living separate worlds.

I’m not here to join them. I’m only here to look, to comment, to try (sometimes in vain) to understand the incomprehensible.

I wander these streets like a vagabond, lost in the town, watching life unfold in fragments I can never fully grasp.

NINFA x Tormius

The Art of Play is a series of 11 abstract pieces, each inspired by a different sport: Fencing, Basketball, Ice Hockey, Bowling, Football, Archery, Skate, Badminton, Baseball, Sailing and Tennis.

The goal is to capture the feeling of movement, tension, and flow behind each game. Every piece is a visual interpretation in my own style which is not figurative but seeks to capture the essence and rhythm.

I wanted to strip away the literal and focus on the energy through shape, color, and composition. Each artwork reflects a kind of motion that lives beyond the rules of the game.

items.title: Self portrait, at night
items.note:
Late at night, when the world falls silent, something opens.  
This is where I paint. Not to be seen, but to listen.  
Ideas don’t arrive fully formed here. They circle, dissolve, return.  
And in their quiet orbit, I find shape.

The light in this piece isn’t just illumination. It’s what keeps me coming back.  
A faint glow that says you’re still here, and you still have something to say.

This is a self-portrait, not of my face,  
but of the time, the silence,  
and the belief that it has to be shared, or it will disappear.

items.title: LAYERS #9677
items.note:
Developed by gallery-led platform DRP.io, LAYERS by Vhils is the first evolutionary NFT project in which collectors can co-create artworks through interacting with tokens on-chain. Each NFT is revealed layer-by-layer through holders choosing how to "tear” their artworks.

How you tear your LAYER also determines your collector journey as part of Vhils’ collector community and your access to his calendar of exclusive art projects, on and off chain. Through staking, burning and merging NFTs at various stages of reveal, LAYERS can be converted into physical artworks, NFTs and experiences.

Through staking, burning and merging NFTs at various stages of reveal, LAYERS can be converted into physical artworks, NFTs and experiences.

This work represents Lister's punk media art style, fusing physical art with digital techniques.
